fichas.title: Laundry: equipment, laundry quantities, and washing capacity
fichas.summary: Laundry workshop reference showing automatic washers, dryers, washer/dryers, rotary and flatbed irons, with side views and equipment dimensions. The text gives typical weekly dry-laundry quantities for different building types and illustrates washing-capacity calculations for hotels, care facilities, and a residential block.
uses: Estimating weekly dry-laundry production and required washing capacity
